objective: Repair the production-reported mentoring lesson report submit action: show actionable missing-field feedback instead of an unexplained disabled button while preserving proof and authorization.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: current source implementation on main and the Genesis release candidate inspected on 2026-11-20, identical mentor-evidence.tsx blob 5fc4fad59db81c75eeafd40d436a21f20ad8874a. User screenshot shows the submit button disabled in their production app. This is a source inspection plus user-reported runtime symptom, NOT a verified production OTA or APK fingerprint.
chosenApproach: Display first missing form requirement inline; allow the button to display all missing requirements until submission is eligible. Keep existing server-enforced fields, private image/consent, action lock, request-key idempotency and retry.
selectionRationale: The previous button was disabled for any incomplete field without telling the mentor which requirement blocked submission. A complete report can still be submitted unchanged; incomplete reports receive actionable guidance.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Change only the mentoring report's disabled submit interaction and field-level feedback without changing session persistence or private evidence gates.
preservedBehaviors: No incomplete report or duplicate report is sent; only authenticated mentor submissions with assigned learners, genuine teaching photo and explicit consent can progress.
Existing action mutex, idempotent receipt, private image bucket and System Admin review remain unchanged.

preserveBehaviors: No changes to Supabase schema, RLS, photo bucket ACL, reward rules or app navigation.
Authenticated teacher must select a reportable lesson and assigned learners, enter a venue and minimum 20-character teaching notes, and consent to a private photo upload.
No ad placement, background assets, theme, native package or OTA channel changes.
No production promotion until mandatory RC, ad/nav, and runtime-compatibility checks pass.
acceptanceChecks: Run focused mentoring UI regression test on PR and existing mentor evidence/receipt tests.
Engineering Accountability protected-feature and exact-scope checks pass.
Verify Android user flow for incomplete form and complete submission against safe test mentor before production OTA.
Confirm exact live build/runtime, release artifact and production served update before calling live.
alternativeApproaches: Remove mentoring evidence or attendance gates: rejected because the server must preserve proof and assigned-participant authorization.
Make the disabled button permanently enabled and bypass validation: rejected because it would generate bad RPC calls.
Modify Supabase permissions without evidence: rejected; authenticated RPC privileges were confirmed available.
